title: Studio 菜单（M3）：左侧菜单读顺序表——分组标题变小号灰字、默认只显示常用、其余收进「高级」
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Part of #36890. Ruling: #37192, comment 7151834490. Proposal: 7151777190 §3.3, §3.5–§3.9, §6 risks. The maintainer asked for this to be dispatched first.

## What

1. `buildStudioMenu` orders each group by the M2 placement table and stamps `tier` on each entry.
   - The four non-type entries get their tier and position in the same function: 组织级流程, 诊断, 默认共享 and 环境 all go to 高级.
2. **常用 types are always listed on a package, whether they hold items or not.** The `always` list becomes the 常用 types.
   - This also fixes a gap: today a new package shows no 应用, 页面, 仪表盘 or 报表 entry.
3. `StudioMenu.tsx` changes how the menu is drawn:
   - Group labels become small and muted, with no count and no link.
   - Entry counts are muted and mean items only.
   - An empty 常用 type is dimmed, shows no number, and stays a link.
   - A group label is drawn only where the group has an entry in that tier.
4. The 「高级」 fold sits below a divider:
   - Closed by default.
   - Remembers its state per browser, in the cookie `studio_menu_advanced`.
   - Opens itself when the current page is one of its entries, without writing the cookie.
   - Search ignores the fold.
   - It is a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
5. `~org` and `~all` have no fold: the same labels, muted counts and table order, drawn flat.
6. ⌘K follows with no change to its model. It reads `buildStudioMenu`'s output and ignores the fold.
7. New i18n keys go in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`. Add keys only; remove none.

## Done when

- Every point above is pinned by a test that goes red on revert. That includes the self-opening fold on a bookmark to a 高级 type, and the always-listed empty 常用 types.
- `studioMenuModel.test.ts:64` ("all six groups, an empty one included") is rewritten on purpose.
- No route, address, entry key or entry test id changes. Only the group-count test id goes.
- "Empty" means the sweep answered with none, not that the sweep has not answered yet (`settled`).
- A browser walk-through on showcase covers:
  - package scope, with 高级 closed and open;
  - a bookmark to 钩子;
  - a new empty package;
  - `~org`.

## Notes

- Waits for the three designer PRs: #37168, #37169 and #37089 all edit `studioMenuModel.ts` and its test. #37166 overlaps only on the i18n files.
- Size M.
- The follow-up decision cards from proposal §3.10 are filed when this card lands:
  - F1: views on the object.
  - F2: mappings in the object's import.
  - F3: the first item of a 高级 type.
